def solve():
    n, k = map(int, input().split())
    allp = list(map(float, input().split()))
    results = []

    for i in range(n):
        if abs(allp[i]) < 1e-6:
            results.append(0.0)
            continue

        p = [allp[j] for j in range(n) if j != i]
        size = n - 1
        dp = [0.0] * (1 << size)
        dp[0] = allp[i]
        ans = dp[0]

        for mask in range(1, 1 << size):
            sumP = 0.0
            sumVal = 0.0
            cnt = 0
            for t in range(size):
                if mask & (1 << t):
                    sumP += p[t]
                    sumVal += p[t] * dp[mask ^ (1 << t)]
                    cnt += 1
            dp[mask] = sumVal / (1 - sumP) if (1 - sumP) != 0 else 0
            if cnt < k:
                ans += dp[mask]
        results.append(ans)

    print(' '.join(map(str, results)))
